name: Cucumber Cream Cheese Sandwich Bento Box with Raspberries, Sweet Potato Wedges & Pesto Mayo

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes a 4-compartment bento box. Please adjust the recipe as needed to accommodate the size of your bento box or food storage containers.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ lb sweet potato
⅓ cup raspberries
¼ English cucumber

instructions.primary_message: Peel and halve sweet potato lengthwise, then cut each half into ½-inch thick wedges. Transfer wedges to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp extra virgin olive oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, flipping halfway through, until potatoes are golden brown and fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool completely, about 20 minutes.
Place raspberries in the first small compartment of the bento box.
Place mayo and pesto in a small bowl. Stir to combine the pesto mayo and place in the second small compartment of the bento box.
Trim and slice cucumber crosswise into very thin rounds.

Place bread on a flat surface. Divide cream cheese between the slices and spread out in an even layer. Cover one of the slices with cucumber, season with salt and pepper, then close sandwich with remaining bread slice. Cut in half and place in the large compartment of the bento box.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 slice whole grain bread
¼ cup whipped cream cheese spread
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the sweet potato wedges are cool, place in the medium compartment of the bento box.
Cover bento box and refrigerate until ready to eat. Enjoy!
